'''Keru Marasa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]<ref name="Zakuul" /> who served in the [[Knights of Zakuul]] during the era in which the [[Eternal Empire]] ruled over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. An elite Knight who held the title of [[Paladin]], Marasa wore dark [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and wielded a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] in battle. She was stationed aboard the [[Tatooine Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] over the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3631 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> when the [[Star Fortress]] was [[Attack on the Tatooine Star Fortress|invaded]] and destroyed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keru Marasa was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] Digital Expansion. She is one of four possible Paladins that can spawn during the Tatooine version of the "The Star Fortress" Flashpoint; as the Star Fortress is destroyed with all hands aboard, this article assumes that Marasa died either in battle or when the [[battle station]] exploded.<ref name="TOR" />
